generation_configuration.scope_disclosure: This pilot evaluates the test pipeline, sentence parsing, abbreviation masking, provenance checking, and rule-based screening calibration. Because summaries were generated by MockProvider rather than a production LLM API, these metrics reflect pipeline calibration rather than production model generation quality.

reconciled_provenance_summary.counting_unit: Citation occurrences (one claim citing one document ID)

novelty_annotation_agreement.diagnostic_framing: Observed kappa values are pilot diagnostics over N=3 queries, demonstrating that the annotation protocol successfully isolates § 102 anticipation from § 103 obviousness. Because N=3 is small, these values reflect calibration rather than general rater reliability.

citation_screening_vs_human_agreement.evaluator_type: Rule-based citation-support screening module (keyword token overlap with stemming & negation checks; NOT semantic NLI)
citation_screening_vs_human_agreement.class_imbalance_analysis: High observed agreement Po (0.9792) with moderate kappa (0.6596) occurs because UNSUPPORTED dominates the pilot dataset (46/48 human, 47/48 module). Cohen's kappa penalizes heavily when marginal distributions are highly skewed; a single disagreement causes a substantial drop in kappa.

novelty_reviews.title: Drone Multispectral Crop Disease Detection and Prescription

Rater_1_IP.uncertainty_rationale: Multispectral imaging and disease detection are known in PAT-003, and variable spraying apparatus in PAT-015; combination would be obvious to a practitioner.
Rater_1_IP.notes: No single reference discloses full drone-to-prescription loop under § 102.

Rater_2_Academic.uncertainty_rationale: Real-time edge telemetry coupling with variable prescription generation has unresolved empirical latency constraints not obvious from static imagery papers.
Rater_2_Academic.notes: Literature (PAP-019) focuses strictly on offline benchmark accuracy.

adjudication.adjudication_rationale: Consensus: § 102 clearly not anticipated as no single prior art documents the full system. Under § 103, pairing drone sensors with sprayers is prima facie obvious, but the research gap regarding real-time closed-loop edge telemetry is genuine and unaddressed in current datasets.

novelty_reviews.title: Multi-Agent Patent Claim Scope Optimization with MCTS

Rater_1_IP.uncertainty_rationale: Tree of Claims (PAP-010) and patent search trees (PAT-001) heavily pre-date this; applying MCTS is an obvious optimization heuristic.
Rater_1_IP.notes: Claim generation algorithms are actively published.

Rater_2_Academic.uncertainty_rationale: Recent ToC literature already explores MCTS rollouts; the gap is narrow engineering tuning rather than conceptual novelty.
Rater_2_Academic.notes: High overlap with PAP-010 benchmark models.

adjudication.adjudication_rationale: Complete agreement: Not anticipated under § 102, obvious extension of ToC literature under § 103, and partially addressed in active NLP literature.

novelty_reviews.title: Cross-Methodology Innovation Reasoning with Dynamic Knowledge Graphs

Rater_1_IP.uncertainty_rationale: TRIZ and SCAMPER mapping to dynamic graph structures has no direct operational equivalent in retrieved patents.
Rater_1_IP.notes: Most patent references (PAT-015, PAT-018) cover physical chemical devices or generic indexing.

Rater_2_Academic.uncertainty_rationale: IdeaForge (PAP-011) implements multi-methodology ideation over knowledge graphs, so the conceptual framework is already published.

adjudication.adjudication_rationale: Adjudicated: While patents do not disclose this (§ 102 not anticipated), academic publication PAP-011 discloses multi-agent ideation graphs, rendering § 103 obvious and the gap partially addressed.
